blocks.text: Rocket apne peechhe lage engines se jalti hui gas bahar phenk kar chalta hai. Jalta hua fuel bohat zyada dabao (high pressure) wali gas ban jata hai jo engines se intehai tez velocity se bahar nikalti hai (Fig. 2.18). Rocket ko utna hi momentum milta hai jitna nikalti gas ka hai, lekin ulti simt mein (momentum conservation). Rocket chalne ke baad bhi engines gas nikalte rehte hain, is liye rocket ka momentum barhta rehta hai. Yani rocket ek jaisi speed se nahi chalta balke jab tak engines chal rahe hon, tez se tez hota jata hai.

blocks.alt: Lamba rocket, safed nose cone aur grey upper stage. Neeche ka hissa kaat kar (cut-away) andar dikhaya gaya hai, oopar se neeche: fuel (liquid hydrogen), liquid oxygen, combustion chamber aur engine ka nozzle, neeche shola.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.18: Rocket ka andaruni (cut-away) manzar (kitab ki Figure 2.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Combustion chamber (jalne ki jagah) mein fuel aur oxygen milte hain. Garam gasein chamber se bohat tez velocity se nikalti hain. Gason ko jitna momentum milta hai, rocket ko bhi utna hi milta hai. Gas aur rocket ek doosre ko dhakelte hain aur ulti simton mein chalte hain.

Rocket apna fuel khud saath le kar chalta hai: liquid ya solid hydrogen aur oxygen. Is liye woh bohat unchai par bhi kaam kar sakta hai jahan hawa bohat kam ya bilkul nahi. Gravity ke khilaf kaafi oopar ka zor (thrust) dene ke liye aam rocket taqreeban 10000 kg s⁻¹ fuel jalata hai aur jali hui gasein 4000 m s⁻¹ se zyada speed se phenkta hai. Darasal rocket ke launch mass ka 80% se zyada sirf fuel hota hai. Fuel ke is bhaari mass ka ek hal yeh hai ke rocket kai rockets ko jor kar banaya jaye.
Jab ek rocket apna kaam kar leta hai to use alag kar ke chhor diya jata hai, aur baqi rockets spacecraft ko aur oopar aur zyada speed se le jate hain.

Agar har second m mass ki gas rocket ke hisaab se velocity v⃗ se nikle, to nikalti gas ke momentum ki har second tabdeeli mv⃗ hai. Yahi engine ka rocket par zor (thrust) hai. Is liye rocket ka acceleration 'a':

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab rocket ki equation a = mv/M ko number (2.42) deti hai, lekin yeh number topic 2.11 mein angle φ wali equation ko pehle hi mil chuka hai. Is equation ka naya number (2.45) hona chahiye; equation khud sahi hai.
Yahan M rocket ka mass hai. Jaise jaise fuel jal kar bahar nikalta hai, rocket ka mass M kam hota hai, is liye acceleration barhta jata hai.

blocks.caption: Rocket ke bare mein khaas baatein

aam rocket ke liye taqreeban 10000 kg s⁻¹

blocks.prompt: 2.0 × 10⁵ kg ka rocket har second 5.0 × 10³ kg gas, rocket ke hisaab se 4000 m s⁻¹ ki speed se nikalta hai. Thrust aur shuru ka acceleration nikalein, aur batayein ke fuel jalne par acceleration ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Thrust = mv = 5.0 × 10³ kg s⁻¹ × 4000 m s⁻¹ = 2.0 × 10⁷ N; a = mv/M = 2.0 × 10⁷ N / 2.0 × 10⁵ kg = 100 m s⁻² (gravity chhor kar; gravity ke saath oopar ka asal acceleration taqreeban 100 - 9.8 ≈ 90 m s⁻²). Fuel nikalne se M kam hota hai jab ke mv wahi rehta hai, is liye acceleration barhta hai.

items: Rocket nikalti gas ke barabar aur ulta momentum leta hai; engines chalne tak tez hota rehta hai. Hydrogen aur oxygen saath, taqreeban 10000 kg s⁻¹ fuel, 4000 m s⁻¹ se zyada speed, 80% se zyada fuel, kai hisson mein bana.
a = mv/M: m = har second nikalne wala mass, v = rocket ke hisaab se gas ki velocity, mv = thrust, M = rocket ka mass (fuel jalne par kam, is liye a barhta hai).
